$comment: Real jobs: tasks a person does with this app, each with an outcome a check can observe. Keyed by job id so scripts/merge-json merges two PRs that add different jobs. scripts/jobs check validates every field; jobs.md beside this file is generated from it on dev (scripts/jobs render), never edited. The fields and the done rule: docs/factory/packets.md, Jobs.

RJ-L01.job: Import 2,000 photos from a card: copy to a dated folder, rename by date, make a second backup copy.
RJ-L01.outcome: 2,000 files in a dated folder, renamed by date the same way in the catalog and on disk, and a second complete copy.
RJ-L01.trap: Rename differs between card and copy; second copy skipped silently

RJ-L02.job: Add a folder in place, then add it again.
RJ-L02.outcome: Nothing is duplicated and nothing moves.
RJ-L02.trap: Same file under a new path imported twice

RJ-L03.job: Cull 500 shots with P, X and stars, Auto Advance on.
RJ-L03.outcome: Each step lands in under 50 ms.
RJ-L03.trap: Auto Advance skips a photo after an undo

RJ-L04.job: Zoom to 100% on an eye to check focus, then step to the next shot at the same spot.
RJ-L04.outcome: The next shot opens at 100% on the same spot.

RJ-L05.job: Compare two frames of a burst side by side with synced zoom.
RJ-L05.outcome: The two frames show side by side, and zoom and pan move both together.

RJ-L06.outcome: They go to the Trash (recoverable), the catalog updates, and a later import doesn't bring them back.
RJ-L06.trap: Removed from the catalog but not from disk, or re-imported from the card

RJ-L07.job: Scroll a 10,000-photo grid of real thumbnails.
RJ-L07.outcome: Stays smooth and the thumbnails are right.
RJ-L07.trap: Placeholders today; jank once real pixels arrive

RJ-L08.outcome: Every rating, flag and edit is there; a damaged catalog is set aside, not lost.
RJ-L08.trap: Catalog reverts to an older state after a forced quit

RJ-L09.job: Show only picked photos with three stars or more.
RJ-L09.outcome: The grid shows only picked photos with three or more stars, and the filter is still set after a relaunch.

RJ-L10.job: Make an album from a selection and add more later.
RJ-L10.outcome: The album lists the photos by reference, with no copies on disk, and later additions show in it.

RJ-L11.job: Tag 40 photos with a keyword and find them by search.
RJ-L11.outcome: A search for the keyword in any letter case finds all 40 photos.

RJ-L12.job: Read a photo's camera, lens, ISO and shutter in the inspector.
RJ-L12.outcome: The inspector shows camera, lens, ISO and shutter, and a rotated photo's size the right way round.
RJ-L12.trap: Rotated phone photo shows swapped size

RJ-L13.job: Fix exposure, white balance and shadows on one photo and sync to 40 others.
RJ-L13.outcome: The 40 photos get the same exposure, white balance and shadows, and keep their own crops.

RJ-L14.job: Crop to 4:5 with a preset and straighten.
RJ-L14.outcome: The photo is cropped to 4:5 and level in the loupe, the thumbnail and the export.

RJ-L15.job: Export 40 photos as JPEG at a 2048 px long edge, quality 85, into a folder.

RJ-L16.outcome: No GPS, serial or MakerNote in the JPEG or in any sidecar; copyright kept if asked.
RJ-L16.needs_note: S11 (the metadata option); library/export-pack adds the row
RJ-L16.trap: The EX-f XMP sidecar or a property copy carries GPS and CreateDate beside a 'clean' JPEG

RJ-L17.job: Export with a text or logo watermark in a corner.
RJ-L17.outcome: The exported files carry the watermark in the chosen corner at the same size relative to the long edge, portrait or landscape.

RJ-L18.job: Edit in Photo and come back.
RJ-L18.outcome: The thumbnail updates and the original is untouched.

RJ-L19.job: Find duplicates across two imported folders.
RJ-L19.outcome: The finder lists the same photo across the two folders as a duplicate, even at two sizes.
RJ-L19.trap: Same photo at two sizes not matched

RJ-L20.outcome: Photos sit under their year and month, and photos with no date sit in their own group, not 1970.
RJ-L20.trap: Photos with no Exif date bunch at 1970

RJ-L21.job: Import RAW+JPEG pairs and see each pair once.
RJ-L21.outcome: Each RAW+JPEG pair shows as one item, and a rating applies to both files.
RJ-L21.needs_note: no packet: RAW+JPEG pairing was cut from library/raw for the beta (re-cut 2026-10-21, open question R1)
RJ-L21.trap: Pair shows twice; rating applies to one half

RJ-L22.job: Open camera RAW files and see the embedded preview at once.
RJ-L22.outcome: RAW files import and show their embedded preview straight away.

RJ-L23.outcome: Launch under 3 s, search under 200 ms.
RJ-L23.needs_note: E12 + a Library large-catalog gate (G1 doesn't list Library)
RJ-L23.trap: Catalog JSON parsed whole on every launch

RJ-L24.job: Browse previews of photos on an unplugged drive; they show as offline.
RJ-L24.outcome: Photos on the unplugged drive stay in the grid with their previews and an offline mark.
RJ-L24.trap: Offline photos vanish from the grid

RJ-L25.job: Undo a rating change made on 300 photos in one step.
RJ-L25.outcome: One undo restores the rating of all 300 photos.
RJ-L25.trap: Undo restores only the first photo

RJ-L26.job: Edit a mixed selection; the inspector shows Mixed and one edit applies to all.
RJ-L26.outcome: The inspector shows Mixed for differing values, and one edit applies to every selected photo.

RJ-L27.job: Set colour labels from keys 6 to 9.
RJ-L27.outcome: Keys 6 to 9 set the matching colour label on the selected photos.

RJ-L28.job: Copy develop settings and paste them on another photo.
RJ-L28.outcome: The other photo gets the develop settings and keeps its own crop.

RJ-L29.job: See video files in the grid with their duration.
RJ-L29.outcome: Video files show in the grid with their duration.

RJ-L30.job: Flag closed-eye and out-of-focus frames in a burst automatically.
RJ-L30.outcome: Closed-eye and out-of-focus frames are flagged, with no network use.
RJ-L30.needs_note: none (open call 1 only names AI culling)

RJ-L31.job: Full-screen preview with the space bar, and back.
RJ-L31.outcome: The space bar opens a full-screen preview, and the space bar, Escape or a visible control closes it.
RJ-L31.trap: No way back with the mouse

RJ-L32.job: Stack a burst under its best frame.
RJ-L32.outcome: The burst shows as one stack topped by the best frame, and rating the stack rates every frame.
RJ-L32.trap: Rating the stack rates only the top

RJ-L33.job: Export with an XMP sidecar; another photo app reads the 3-star rating.
RJ-L33.outcome: The sidecar holds xmp:Rating 3, and a standard XMP reader reports 3 stars.
RJ-L33.trap: Sidecar written but not readable by others

RJ-L41.job: Auto tone and sharpen a dim, flat photo in Develop, then export it for the web.
RJ-L41.outcome: The export's luma spans 0.05 to 0.95, its grey patch reads neutral, and its edges are sharper than an unsharpened export.
RJ-L41.trap: Auto stretches levels but leaves a cast, or the export drops Sharpen

RJ-L42.job: Drop a folder of three photos and a Halo project on Library, then undo.
RJ-L42.outcome: Three photos import in one step and are selected; one undo removes them; the Halo project is handed to Halo.
RJ-L42.trap: Folders aren't expanded, each file is its own undo step, or the Halo project imports as a broken photo

RJ-L70.job: Stand up a sideways 4000x3000 scan with Rotate Right, crop it 4:5 portrait, and export JPEG.
RJ-L70.outcome: The JPEG is 3000x3750 and its top row matches the scan's left column within 2 levels.
RJ-L70.trap: 4:5 on the landscape original gives 5:4, or export ignores the turn

RJ-L50.job: Import a card with two folders by copying to a chosen folder in dated subfolders, then delete the card.
RJ-L50.outcome: Every photo still opens after the card is gone; both files named IMG_0001 exist with different bytes under the dated folders.
RJ-L50.trap: A duplicate name overwrites the first copy, or the catalog still points at the card

RJ-L51.job: Rate three photos, remove them from the catalog, then undo.
RJ-L51.outcome: The three files are still on disk after the remove, and after the undo the photos are back with their ratings.
RJ-L51.trap: Remove deletes the files, or undo brings the photos back without their ratings

RJ-L52.job: Move an imported folder of 40 photos on disk, then locate one of them.
RJ-L52.outcome: One relink makes all 40 photos open again; a same-named file of another size elsewhere is not linked.
RJ-L52.trap: Relink fixes only the photo that was located

RJ-L53.job: Import trips (with 2025 and 2026 inside) and family, then show trips/2025, and trips without its subfolders.
RJ-L53.outcome: Each folder view lists exactly the expected files, and the listed counts match the files on disk.
RJ-L53.trap: A folder named like a prefix of another shows the other's photos, or subfolder counts are added twice

RJ-L54.job: Rate 30 photos over three hourly saves, truncate the catalog file, relaunch, then restore the oldest backup.
RJ-L54.outcome: The relaunch opens the newest good backup with all 30 ratings and says so; after the restore the pre-restore catalog is listed as a backup.
RJ-L54.trap: A damaged catalog opens empty, or a restore overwrites the only good copy

RJ-L55.job: Prepare three geotagged photos for the share sheet.
RJ-L55.outcome: Three JPEGs with a long edge of 2048 and no GPS, serial or MakerNote; after a relaunch the share folder is empty.
RJ-L55.trap: The shared copies keep the location, are full-size originals, or pile up in a temp folder

RJ-L56.job: Open a 10,000-photo catalog headless, select all, rate them 3, and plan an export of 1,000.
RJ-L56.outcome: Open in 400 ms or less, rate-all as one step in 200 ms or less, the export plan in 50 ms or less (debug).
RJ-L56.trap: Fine at 200 photos, stalls at 10,000 (a quadratic scan in select or plan)
